source_identification: Twenty-six calculus questions of GRE Mathematics Test Form GR8767 (Questions 4, 6-8, 11-13, 16, 19-21, 27-31, 36, 39, 41, 44-46, 51, 56, 59, 63), each page cropped from the scanned test booklet, followed by the form's answer key and percentage worksheet. The PDF's crop boxes hide the other questions on the scanned pages; the displayed selection is the source.
extraction_corrections: Question 12 choice (B): the extraction reads e^pi, duplicating (C); page 5 of the PDF prints e pi.
Questions 6, 7, 41 and 59: figures emitted as image placeholders; pages 2, 3, 14 and 19 were rendered to assets/attachments/gr8767-calculus-figures/ and embedded on the cards.
